answer: Sybil resistance as controlled access: new identities dock at a jetty of reduced emission until peer-graded original work proves them. The path to full share is a canyon—easy to enter once, costly to flood—because each correlated clone posts a rising basalt bond that multiplies stake cost. Fakes never inherit non-transferable graded history, so attackers burn capital at the jetty while mass accounts stay capped inside the canyon.
